title: Cordelia aims to bring India among top 5 global cruise markets by 2032
description:
Cordelia Cruises aims to make India one of the world's top five cruise markets by 2032 as it plans to expand its fleet and tap the growing potential of domestic cruise tourism, its President and CEO Jurgen Bailom said.
The company currently operates two vessels, Cordelia Empress and Cordelia Sky, and its third ship, Cordelia Sun, is likely to join the fleet earlier than scheduled, Bailom said at a press conference aboard Cordelia Sky off the Mumbai coast.
Cordelia Sky is the company's latest addition to its fleet and has commenced commercial operations from Mumbai.
"We have three ships: two in operation, which are Empress and Sky, and Cordelia Sun is coming, most probably earlier than expected. With that, we will have three ships," Bailom said.
He said the company was also planning further fleet expansion but did not disclose specific numbers as it is now a listed entity and subject to market regulations.
